name: Using the placed Ancestral Keg applies its heal and mana aura (#5802)
contract: Ancestral Keg 804748 places gameobject 9000118 (type 22, GAMEOBJECT_TYPE_SPELLCASTER). A spellcaster object casts its Data0 spell on the user; the DBC names exactly one aura spell for the keg, 570762 'Ancestral Keg' (SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL every 2000 ms), which triggers 572066 'Ancestral Keg' (SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL_PCT 4 and SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE_PCT 4). With Data0 unset, using the placed keg does nothing; with Data0 570762 the user receives the aura.

steps.label: The Ancestral Keg gameobject is placed near the caster
No keg aura before using the keg
Using the keg applies the Ancestral Keg aura
